headline: José Luis Castro: Jamaica Gleaner editorial shows need for a national COPD response
dek: The WHO Director-General's Special Envoy for Chronic Respiratory Diseases shared an editorial on COPD in Jamaica, calling for sustained health policy attention and public investment.
body:
José Luis Castro, WHO Director-General Special Envoy for Chronic Respiratory Diseases, has drawn attention to a Jamaica Gleaner editorial on chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) in Jamaica.

Writing on LinkedIn, Castro said the editorial, titled "Confronting the quiet respiratory crisis", highlights the significant burden of COPD in the country and the need for a coordinated national response.

He wrote that earlier diagnosis, stronger tobacco control, cleaner air and better integration of respiratory care into primary health services can help prevent suffering and improve lives.

Castro added that chronic respiratory diseases deserve sustained attention in health policy and public investment. He linked to the editorial in his post.
key_quote: Chronic respiratory diseases deserve sustained attention in health policy and public investment.
